business.name: Dentons Catering Equipment
business.notes: The project owner confirms this business was still trading at 2-4 Clapham High Street when photographed on 2026-04-03. The fascia reads dentons catering equipment. Its website describes a family-run business: https://www.dentonscatering.com/about-us (checked 2026-10-29). No chain or multiple simultaneous retail branches are established. The website address on the fascia redirects to https://www.dentonscatering.com/. The owner reports closure of the Clapham shop on Friday 2026-05-01, corroborated by the company's own LinkedIn announcement: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/denton%27s-catering-equipment-limited_dentons-onthemove-endofanera-activity-7456976259806445568-FUzm . That post states the business continued from South Wimbledon without a public-facing shop; this was not closure of the entire business. Original source supplied by the owner: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dentons-onthemove-endofanera-share-7456976256807661568-cNxB/ . The announcement says 90 years on Clapham High Street; no exact opening date is inferred.

observation.notes: The project owner confirms Dentons was still trading at the time of this photograph. The closed central shutter at 07:58 local time is not evidence of vacancy. Catering equipment remains in both windows with relocation sale signs. A subsequent company announcement confirms the Clapham shop closed on 2026-05-01 and the business relocated to South Wimbledon.

occupancy_notes: Dentons occupied this shop when photographed on 2026-04-03, as confirmed by the project owner. This is an observation date, not the opening date. The company's LinkedIn announcement confirms its final trading day here was 2026-05-01, before continuing from South Wimbledon; valid_to records that supported final trading day, inclusively. The published event is also recorded in the website timeline and business notes; no vacant observation or post-closure occupant is invented.
